fact: At the 12 June 2025 technical group session on the government interoperability platform, INAGE named DNIC and DNRN as the main sources of civil identity data and said interoperating the BI and birth registration systems is a prerequisite for any citizen-facing digital service.
title: INAGE, IP Lidera Implementação da Plataforma de Interoperabilidade Centrada no Cidadão
